messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: [P0] High GPU queue growth on prod-eu-1: gpu-pool-main. HPA for gpu-workers not scaling. Auto-page sent.

pager-ops: paging oncall-alyssa - severity: urgent. see runbook `gpu-exhaustion`.

oncall-alyssa: Acknowledged. pulling up queues and hpa status. Seeing 5x queue in last 3m, some 429s reported by LB.

eng-sre-sam: `kubectl get hpa -n inference gpu-workers -o wide` shows currentReplicas=3, desired=3, metrics missing (stale). `kubectl describe` shows "failed to get metric: timed out".

ml-jess: Prom-adapter reports `500` on /metrics for k8s API when queried for custom metrics. adapter logs: "error: query timeout querying Prometheus: context deadline exceeded".

infra-kiran: Prometheus instance prom-main-eu1 has high WAL segments and remote_write retries. Disk iops at 1200, cpu 80%. The node group for prometheus is pinned low.

oncall-alyssa: Impact note: customers on prod-eu-1 receiving increased latency and occasional 503/429. Likely cause: metrics ingestion/backlog -> adapter not serving -> HPA stops receiving signals -> no autoscale. Immediate mitigations?

eng-sre-sam: Options: 1) Soft fix: bump gpu-workers deployment replicas manually to 12. 2) Restart prom-adapter pods to clear hung queries. 3) Temporarily route low-priority tenants to reserved pool. 4) Increase ASG max size for gpu-pool-main. 5) Recreate Prometheus pod with larger disk iops (risky). Recommend 2+1 concurrently.

oncall-alyssa: Do 2 (restart adapter) + 1 (manual scale) now. Sam, restart adapter with rolling restart. Kiran, request ASG increase. Jess, prepare customer advisory.

eng-sre-sam: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter` -> restarting pods. Watching logs: adapter starting, re-registering metrics.

infra-kiran: ASG increase requested: gpu-pool-main max +5 nodes. Cloud autoscaler shows scale up accepted. ETA node ready 6-9m.

ml-jess: Drafting update: "We are mitigating degraded inference throughput in EU region. We have restarted metrics adapter and are manually scaling workers. Next update in 15 minutes."

eng-sre-sam: Manual scale executed: `kubectl scale deploy/gpu-workers -n inference --replicas=12`. Some pods `Pending` due to insufficient nodes, but many scheduled on available capacity. Queue length dropping ~40% in 4m.

cust-support-bot: Posting interim customer message to status page and emailing impacted tenants.

infra-kiran: Prometheus still under pressure, WAL retention spiked from 2h to 24h due to remote_write retries. We need longer-term changes but current writes are being throttled by remote storage.

noncall-alyssa: Observed fallback behavior: requests for large tenants were being rate-limited at ingress; fallback to cached responses for certain flows reduced load. Good to keep those limits for now.

eng-sre-sam: Adapter reports metrics again, but query latencies are high (~700-1200ms). HPA saw updated custom metrics after adapter restart, but HPA controller needs ~1m to recompute. Desired replicas now 10.

ml-jess: Confirming with logs: some inference pods returned 429 at 10:21:20 to 10:24:00 window. Support flagged 3 enterprise tenants.

infra-kiran: Nodes from ASG are provisioning. Once new nodes join, Pending pods schedule and queue drains. Observed cloud API rate-limit briefly slowed node creation.

eng-sre-sam: Queue now close to baseline. No new 429s in last 3m. We'll hold manual scale and HPA adjustment for 15m.

noncall-alyssa: Actions taken: prom-adapter restart ✅, manual scale to 12 ✅ (some pending until nodes arrived), ASG bumped +5 (in progress), ingress rate-limits applied for non-critical tenants ✅, customers notified ✅.

ml-jess: Post-incident notes: we should add a lightweight direct-scrape metrics path for HPA signals (small job if prometheus is overloaded), plus liveness probes on prom-adapter to force restart earlier. Also consider reducing retention during high-ingest to limit WAL blowout.

infra-kiran: RCA hypothesis: a write surge to remote storage caused Prometheus WAL backlog -> increased scrape/query latencies -> prom-adapter timed out -> custom metrics stale -> HPA didn't scale. Contributing factors: ASG limit low, slow node provisioning, no fast fallback path for HPA metrics.

eng-sre-sam: Temporary follow-ups: add preemptive autoscaler bump when queue rate increases beyond threshold; add alert for prom-adapter query latency; implement a fallback that treats stale metrics as signal to scale conservatively.

noncall-alyssa: I'll schedule the postmortem and owner assignments. tagging @infra and @ml for fixes. Handing off to kiran to own the RCA and change requests.

incidents-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2025-1101. Start: 2025-07-05T10:32:01Z. Status: mitigated -> monitoring.

cust-support-bot: Final customer update posted: "We've mitigated the issue and scaled capacity; engineering is investigating root cause related to metrics ingestion backlog. We'll share a follow-up once RCA complete."

eng-sre-sam: Monitoring 30m more. No further errors so far.

infra-kiran: Acknowledged. Collecting Prometheus WAL metrics, remote_write logs, adapter traces, and ASG event history for RCA.

oncall-alyssa: Thanks team. Handing to infra/owner for next steps. :thumbsup:
